name: IDPH Ambulatory Surgical Treatment Center Directory

columns.name: Facility Name
columns.description: Legal name of the facility as registered with the Illinois Department of Public Health, including any "DBA" designation.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Physical street address of the facility, including suite or floor where applicable.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Municipality where the facility is physically located.

columns.name: County
columns.description: Illinois county where the facility is physically located.

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: Five-digit U.S. Postal Service ZIP Code for the facility's physical location.

columns.name: Contact Name
columns.description: Name and credentials of the facility's designated administrative contact on file with IDPH.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Primary contact telephone number for the facility.

columns.name: Exp. Date
columns.description: Date on which the facility's current operating license expires and renewal is required.
